description: This Java source file defines the TimeoutInvalidException class, a specific type of runtime exception used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to indicate invalid timeout values in messaging. It includes static factory methods, a builder pattern implementation, serialization/deserialization support, and annotations for immutability and deprecation.

classes.name: TimeoutInvalidException
classes.description: An immutable exception class thrown when a message timeout value is invalid, deprecated in favor of a newer exception class.
